review.instruction: Confirm the endpoint and served head come from the bound runtime evidence, the served head contains the applied commit, the actual rendered family version is recorded, and guarded routes were reached without exposing credentials.

Confirm every selected primary surface and required viewport, color scheme and journey state has a capture, screenshot and verdict; deferred states have reasons and no journey-required state was silently deferred.

Trace every judged claim to a measured rendered node, its owner, applicable rule and actual browser evidence. Reject claimed values, screenshots without measurements and measurements copied from another matrix entry.

Confirm presentation, composition, responsive, motion, accessibility, contrast, render truth and taste close independently by their published rules, with unavailable evidence blocked rather than passed and failures routed to the node owner.
Inspect every actual screenshot and verify taste scoring used the same auditor, frozen scope and complete calibration anchors. Check the worst relevant capture remains visible with the verdict.

failurePolicy: Use the bounded feedback loop to identify exact missing captures, measurements, rules or visual defects, recapture or reassess only the affected matrix entries, and return done only after every criterion passes.
